info.title: marktd — Master Data Manager
info.description: REST API for the `marktd` master-data daemon (Marktlokation, Messlokation, Verträge, Partner, Subscriptions, Process Correlation, VersorgungsStatus, PRICAT).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/lokationsbuendelstrukturen` — every published
Lokationsbündelstruktur with its Bezeichnung, so a reader names a
`lokationsbuendelcode` without a copy of the Codeliste.

parameters.name: zuordnungstyp
parameters.description: Filter by `zuordnungstyp` in active role assignments (e.g. `NB`, `LF`).

parameters.name: rollencodenummer
parameters.description: Filter by `rollencodenummer` (GLN) in active role assignments.

parameters.name: fallgruppe
parameters.description:
Filter by Gas GaBi RLM Fallgruppe (e.g. `GABI_RLM_MIT_TAGESBAND`).
Gas only — Strom MaLos have no Fallgruppe.

parameters.name: stichtag
parameters.description: The date the bündel is resolved for (YYYY-MM-DD)

put.description:
# Single-write-path invariant (MaLo ↔ MeLo)

This PUT is the only writer of the `melo.malo_id` FK, and the repository
maintains the corresponding `melo → malo` edge in the temporal
`lokationszuordnungen` graph in the same transaction: the graph is always a
superset of the FK (the FK is a derived convenience for "current parent"),
and reparenting closes the previous open edge (`valid_to`). See
`marktd::pg::melo` for the reconciliation rules.

get.description:
Returns the typed BO4E `Standorteigenschaften` for the MeLo — carrying
`StandorteigenschaftenStrom` (regelzone EIC, bilanzierungsgebietEic) and/or
`StandorteigenschaftenGas` (druckstufe). Required for Redispatch 2.0
`NetworkConstraintDocument` cross-references and Gas billing zone routing.

Returns 404 when the MeLo has no `standorteigenschaften` column populated yet.
Use `PUT /api/v1/melos/{id}` with a `data.standorteigenschaften` field to populate it.

404.description: MeLo not found or no Standorteigenschaften

put.description:
Idempotent on the natural key `(sparte, nb_mp_id, msb_mp_id, valid_from)`;
the record id stays stable across re-submits. A non-zero `version` in the
body acts as an optimistic-locking guard. The row and its CloudEvent
commit in one transaction.

200.description: Upserted; returns stable id and new version

412.description: Supplied version does not match the stored version

422.description: An invalid window, a Strom row with a Gas-only status, or a window overlapping another contract of the same parties and Sparte

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege/check` — is a contract `abgeschlossen`
and valid on `datum`?
get.description:
Always `200` with a Befund: `abgeschlossen: false` names why (no contract,
only offered, to be adapted, ended). A database failure is `500`, never a
`false` — an outage is not evidence that no contract exists.

parameters.name: nb_mp_id
parameters.description: The NB's MP-ID in that Sparte

parameters.name: datum
parameters.description: The day the contract must be valid on (YYYY-MM-DD)

400.description: A missing or malformed query parameter

patch.description:
Used by the makod sender (`uebermittelt`/`fehlgeschlagen`) and by the
operator or answer channel (`bestaetigt`/`abgelehnt`).

412.description: expected_version does not match the stored version

post.description:
Enqueue immediate (re-)dispatch of the latest PRICAT version for the given NB
to all currently active LF partners.

The actual dispatch happens asynchronously in the background. Returns `202
Accepted` with the version ID that was queued.

Use this endpoint to manually trigger dispatch after an AS4 connectivity
incident, or to force re-distribution to newly on-boarded LF partners without
waiting for the next scheduled scan.

parameters.name: nb_mp_id
parameters.description: NB GLN to dispatch PRICAT for

404.description: No PRICAT version found for this NB

get.description:
Returns the dispatch audit log for a specific PRICAT version — one entry per
LF partner that was reached (or attempted).

Returns all versioned PRICAT snapshots for the given NB GLN, newest first.
Each entry includes dispatch state so operators can monitor the pipeline.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/versorgung/{malo_id}` — the current supply state, or with
`?at=YYYY-MM-DD` the state as of that German calendar day.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description:
Point-in-time date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (German local time, i.e. CET/CEST).

When present, returns the supply state as it was at end-of-day on this date,
reconstructed from the history log.  Omit for the current state.

200.description: The supply state; `ETag` carries its version

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/versorgung/{malo_id}/history` — the supply-state change
history, newest first, paged.

Angaben.description: The NB's Angaben of the bündel no BO4E object carries — one dated row.

Kante.description:
One edge of the bündel valid on the Stichtag, half-open
`[valid_from, valid_to)`.

Lokationsbuendel.description:
The Lokationsbündel of a Marktlokation on a Stichtag — the read model
behind the Geschäftsdatenanfrage answers 55035 / 55095 / 55060 (UTILMD AHB
Strom 2.2 Kap. 9.5). Its wire is [`MaloLokationsbuendel`]'s, which makod
reads with `deny_unknown_fields`, so it carries no field that type lacks;
the Lokationsbündelstruktur's wording is [`lokationsbuendelstrukturen`].

oneOf.description: The NB's Angaben row covering the Stichtag.

lokationsbuendelcodes.description:
Every distinct `lokationsbuendelcode` the bündel's edges carry; more
than one is a graph that disagrees with itself.

objekte.description: Every object reached, the Marktlokation itself first.

stichtag.description: The date every edge and the Angaben row are resolved for.

zaehler.description: The Zähler of the bündel's Messlokationen.

zuordnungen.description: Every edge valid on the Stichtag that reached them.

bezeichnung.description: Its Bezeichnung in the Codeliste der Lokationsbündelstrukturen.

Lokationsbuendelstrukturen.description:
The Codeliste der Lokationsbündelstrukturen (EDI@Energy, BDEW V1.0,
31.03.2023), as `rubo4e::lokationsbuendel::STRUKTUREN` carries it.

bilanzierungsgebiet.description:
Bilanzierungsgebiet EIC code extracted from `data.bilanzierungsgebiet`.
Used by `processd` NB check 4 as primary source; falls back to `malo_grid` when absent.

bilanzierungsmethode.description:
Billing mode extracted from `Marktlokation.bilanzierungsmethode`.

Values: `"RLM"` | `"SLP"` | `"TLP_GEMEINSAM"` | `"TLP_GETRENNT"` | `"PAUSCHAL"` | `"IMS"`.
`"RLM"` → `netzbilanzd` includes Leistungspreis position (`spitzenleistung_kw` required).
`"SLP"` → Arbeitspreis only.

data.description:
Validated BO4E `Marktlokation` payload in canonical camelCase form.
Schema is enforced on every `PUT` — enum fields like `bilanzierungsmethode`
and `netzebene` are rejected with 422 if they contain unknown values.

energierichtung.description:
BO4E `Energierichtung`, named from the grid's point of view:
`"EINSP"` = generation (feeds the grid), `"AUSSP"` = consumption.

fallgruppe.description:
Gas GaBi RLM Fallgruppe (`data["fallgruppenzuordnung"]`) — determines GaBi billing
category. Values: `GABI_RLM_MIT_TAGESBAND` | `GABI_RLM_OHNE_TAGESBAND` |
`GABI_RLM_IM_NOMINIERUNGSERSATZVERFAHREN`. Required for Gas MMM settlement routing.

fernsteuerbar.description:
§14a EnWG „Status der Fernsteuerbarkeit" (`true` = technisch fernsteuerbar,
`false` = nicht fernsteuerbar). Populated from UTILMD `CCI+7037` Z97/Z96.

netzebene.description:
Voltage/pressure level extracted from `data.netzebene` — a BO4E
`Netzebene` wire value (`"NSP"`, `"MSP"`, `"HSP"`, `"HSS"`, `"MSP_NSP_UMSP"`, …).
Available immediately on write; no separate grid provisioning needed.

regelzone.description:
Regelzone EIC code (`Marktlokation.regelzone`) — maps to the ÜNB for MABIS IFTSTA 21000
routing and Redispatch 2.0 Stammdaten forwarding (VNB → ÜNB).

data.description:
Validated BO4E `Messlokation` payload in canonical camelCase form.
`_typ` is auto-injected on write; enum fields validated on write.

netzebene_messung.description: Voltage/pressure level at the metering point (`Messlokation.netzebeneMessung`).

regelzone.description:
Regelzone EIC code extracted from `standorteigenschaften.eigenschaftenStrom[0].regelzone`.
Maps this MeLo to the ÜNB for Redispatch 2.0 Stammdaten routing.

standorteigenschaften.description:
Full BO4E `Standorteigenschaften` JSONB — carries `StandorteigenschaftenStrom`
(regelzone, bilanzierungsgebietEic) and `StandorteigenschaftenGas` (druckstufe).
Required for Redispatch 2.0 `NetworkConstraintDocument` and Gas billing zones.

data.description:
Full BO4E MESSLOKATION payload.

The BO4E schema version is **not** a request field: it is provenance,
and only the server knows which series it parsed the payload under. It
is returned on the `GET`.

MsbRahmenvertrag.description:
An MSB framework-contract record **as stored**.

The natural key is `(tenant, sparte, nb_mp_id, msb_mp_id, valid_from)` —
upserts are idempotent on it and keep the `id` stable.

`vertrag` reads back as opaque JSON, the way every stored BO4E document in
mako does: a row may predate the current schema series. What goes *in* is
[`MsbRvUpsertRequest`], gated.

fassung.description:
Contract text edition. Gas: `KoV XV Anlage 8` unless named otherwise
(legacy: `BK7-17-026`). Strom: as the parties name it, or absent.

version.description: Optimistic-locking version, incremented on every successful write.

MsbRvBefund.description: What the registry says about one (Sparte, NB, MSB, day).

abgeschlossen.description:
`true` only when a contract with status `abgeschlossen` is valid on
`datum`.

oneOf.description: The contract covering `datum`, when one does.

MsbRvStatus.description: Lifecycle state of an MSB framework contract.

MsbRvUpsertRequest.description:
The `PUT /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege` body.

Separate from [`MsbRahmenvertrag`] because the two directions are not
symmetric: what is **written** must cross the BO4E gate, and what is
**read** is whatever was stored.

fassung.description:
Contract text edition. Absent on a Gas row stores [`FASSUNG_GAS`];
absent on a Strom row stores nothing.

id.description: Optional: an id to keep stable. Absent → allocated on insert.

sparte.description:
`STROM` or `GAS` — required: the NB holds one MP-ID per Sparte, and a
contract of one Sparte never answers the other's lookup.

vertrag.description:
The BO4E `Vertrag` (vertragsart `RAHMENVERTRAG`), crossing
[the gate](mako_markt::bo4e::decode) as it deserialises.

Absent stores the empty object the column defaults to, not `null`.

Obis.description: One OBIS-Kennzahl of the Marktlokation with its Verwendungszwecke.

objektcode.description:
BO4E `lokationsbuendelObjektcode` — the object's position in the
Lokationsbündelstruktur.

Objekttyp.description: The kind of object in a Lokationsbündel.

PriCatVersionSummary.description: One entry in the PRICAT version history list.

valid_to.description: End of validity period, or `null` for open-ended.

Register.description: The Wertegranularität of one register of a Zähler.

expected_version.description:
Optimistic-locking guard: the version the caller last read. When
supplied and stale, the update fails with a version-conflict problem
response instead of overwriting.

Verfahren.description: The Verfahren of a normiertes Profil.

VersorgungsStatusHistorie.description: One page of a Marktlokation's supply-state history, newest first.

total.description: Every change recorded for the Marktlokation, not only this page's.

VersorgungsStatusHistoryResponse.description: One supply-state change of a Marktlokation.

valid_from.description: The instant this state became active (RFC 3339).

zuordnungen.description: The assignment list as it stood at `valid_from`.

VersorgungsStatusResponse.description: The VersorgungsStatus of a Marktlokation — now, or as it stood on a date.

eog_seit.description: Start of the running Ersatz-/Grundversorgung (§38/§36 EnWG), if any.

lf_mp_id.description:
The single active Lieferant, when there is exactly one.

Derived from `zuordnungen` and **absent on a tranchierte
Marktlokation**, where no single supplier exists — read `zuordnungen`
there rather than treating the omission as „unsupplied".

lf_mp_id_next.description:
The single announced Lieferant, when exactly one Anmeldung is pending.
Derived, with the same caveat as `lf_mp_id`.

updated_at.description:
When this state was written (RFC 3339) — for a state read `at` a date,
when that historic state became active.

zuordnungen.description:
Every Lieferant holding a share of this Marktlokation — the authoritative
answer to „who supplies it". A tranchierte Marktlokation carries several.

Zaehler.description: A Zähler of one of the bündel's Messlokationen.

Zuordnung.description: One Lieferant's share of a Marktlokation.

lf_mp_id.description: MP-ID of the Lieferant holding this share.

process_id.description: The process that wrote this assignment.

prozent.description: The share in percent — `100` for an untranchierte Marktlokation.

zuordnungsbeginn.description: Zuordnungsbeginn — the Lieferbeginn of this assignment.

Zuordnungsstatus.description: Whether a Zuordnung is announced (Anmeldung in flight) or running.
